source_caption_text:
8 years ago today, $tupid Young pulled up to VladTV for one of the biggest sit-down interviews of his early music career. 🔥🇰🇭

At the time, the Long Beach Cambodian rapper was in the middle of a major breakout. His collaboration with Mozzy, “Mando,” had become his biggest record yet, and when VladTV sat down with him in September 2018, the music video had already passed 10 million views on YouTube. Today, that same video has grown to 69 million+ views, showing just how much the record continued to resonate over the years.

Just weeks before the VladTV interview, $tupid Young also appeared in No Jumper’s “Inside the Asian Crip Gangs of Long Beach” with Adam22. The video took viewers through Long Beach while giving a wider audience an introduction to $tupid Young, his Cambodian roots, and the community he represented. The video has since surpassed 14 million views, becoming one of the most-viewed videos on the No Jumper channel.

The VladTV interview became much bigger than just a conversation about music. Across the multi-part series, $tupid Young spoke about his upbringing in Long Beach, his Cambodian family’s history, his experiences growing up around gang culture, his relationship with his father, and how his life experiences influenced the music he was making. Vlad also spoke with him about “Mando,” including his collaboration with Mozzy and how the record helped change the trajectory of his career.

Looking back, this was a snapshot of $tupid Young right as he was beginning to break through nationally. “Mando” was taking off, the No Jumper documentary had introduced him to millions of viewers, and VladTV gave him another major platform to tell his story and represent Long Beach and Cambodian culture to a much larger hip-hop audience.

8 years later, who remembers $tupid Young’s VladTV interview⁉️🇰🇭
